title: Shared owned-data admission and runner 0.5.0 / 0.3.1 candidate
body:
This is a draft **source proposal only**, relating to [BCF #93](https://github.com/561-group/bare-cedar-fog-services-section/issues/93), [CDE #55](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/computer-deployment-engine/issues/55), and [CDE #48](https://github.com/red-cup-engineering/computer-deployment-engine/issues/48). Those original native and host receiving obligations remain open.

Add shared owned-data admission through the existing `./config` owner: the explicit section-root validator, CDE section/data adapter, and confined destination metadata receiving. Preserve the original resolver and all source capabilities. Select the existing JSNodePackage 0.5.0 runner for the original declared scripts; 0.3.1 is a deliberate additive candidate permitted by the original Code release policy, not a published release claim. Exactly six paths change; all 27 source files are bound by snapshot `aea503bb5649df85c00a47ea4c40a090dc66ec1dc0804edf6552c6c132b67c4e`.

**Received source qualification:** 62/62 source cases, including all original 49 and 13 shared-owner controls, ran with actual `HOME` and `CODEX_HOME` unchanged. The original source receipt `c473e018…` and substantive corrected-context receipt `03dcf159…` are both included unchanged; the earlier altered-HOME run is retained as antecedent rather than relabeled. The separate original seven runner controls also remain context-limited; they are not full selected-runner/package qualification.

**Whole native package qualification remains UNMET.** The actual one lock-only metadata attempt was refused before scope dispatch, Code file-consumer installation, or NPM resolution: Windows physical available 102,947,524,608 bytes, minus the unchanged 6 GiB aggregate promise, double 2 GiB native growth and double 64 MiB overhead, left 92,075,888,640 bytes, below the 100,000,000,000-byte floor. Exact refusal index `1abb2c3026d114b5999350f405a991ab2a1ed65e78a51e7717b84a41e5bbe594`; all inputs unchanged and scope inactive/dead/empty. No generated lock or dependency graph exists. No promise trimming, GC or blind retry is authorized by this draft.

Next: genuinely changed capacity through the original admission predicates; a new exclusive original Code native-forward/lock-only attempt; actual lock identities/SRIs and size basis; qualified whole own dependency installation and original scripts covering all five test files/fifteen syntax entries; actual packing/public exports; deliberate registry publication/artifact receiving; installed useful caller operation and downstream BCF/CDE/host receiving. This draft neither closes those gates nor authorizes merge, registry PUT, Actions dispatch or activation. No raw logs or extra source files are published.
